sub_site: pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma tissue (EUS-FNB and surgical core biopsy)

evidence.quote: We used EUS-FNB to obtain pancreatic cancer tissues from six patients. We obtained tissue samples from four patients during surgery.
The hypervariable region V3-V4 of bacterial 16S rRNA genes was amplified by polymerase chain reaction

notes: Pilot feasibility study (9 patients, 10 samples). No genus names reported anywhere in text, captions or tables; profiles only summarised as alpha-diversity/PCoA figures. No supplements available. No negative controls or decontamination.
